title: Research-oriented longitudinal data audit
question: What temporal information actually exists in the course dataset, and which of the five surviving research directions remain feasible after auditing row grain, visit density, label lineage, pollution lineage, post-event history, missingness, censoring, and calendar structure?
acceptance_criteria: Confirm row grain and patient/date keys
Audit visit-count and pre-event history-depth distributions
Reconstruct NAFLD2_1() label lineage and ultrasound state history
Determine whether post-event visits are retained and quantify 0→1→0 / 1→0 transitions
Audit annual vs rolling pollution exposure lineage
Decompose pollution variation by township, calendar year, and residual township×year variation
Plot calendar-time changes in cohort mix, outcome detection, visit intensity, pollution and major metabolic variables
Issue GO/NO-GO verdict for all five exploration lines
Identify at least one empirical fact that materially changes the research formulation
